content.rendered:
Congratulations class of 2026! We look forward to joining you as you celebrate your final year of high school.  Please check back frequently as this page will continually be updated to give you the most up-to-date information.

Graduation

June 5th, 2026 at 7:00pm at Sherwood High School Stadium

Senior Class Motto

“You don’t have to see the whole staircase, just take the first step.”

– Martin Luther King

Senior Class Meeting Dates:

October 23rd (during FLEX)- Jostens representatives will be handing out ordering materials. Meeting Agenda

February 5 (panoramic picture)-

April 13-

May 28-

Senior Panoramic Photo

The Senior panoramic photo will be taken on Thursday, February 5th. This is a group photo of the class of 2026. You can order this picture through Dorian Studios. In the search bar on the Dorian site, enter Sherwood High School.

Jostens Cap and Gown Information

Sherwood HS Graduation Order Deadline: TBD

Order cap, gown, and tassel here

SHS approved cap and gown required to participate in the graduation ceremony.  

  • You can order through Jostens
  • You can borrow from a sibling or friend who recently graduated from SHS (you will need to bring in the cap/gown to Gwen in the main office to make sure the dye-lot matches the current cap/gowns)
  • If you are unable to purchase or borrow, please let your counselor know and we will help you get one!  We want everyone to participate in the graduation ceremony!
  • Questions about your Josten’s order??
    • Contact Mike Thul @ michael.thul@jostens.com OR 503-723-8006

Senior Yearbook Information (The Quiver ’26)

The Quiver Website

Senior Portrait Requirements:

  • Vertical head and shoulder shots only (like a regular school photo). Do not cut off the top of head, or zoom in on the face.
  • No full body photos, use of animals, props or costuming, silly faces, etc.
  • Full color with a resolution minimum of 300 DPI.
  • All submissions must be done with a Gmail account.

We hope you will select a photo that helps you look your best, shows your unique personality, and meets our guidelines. 

Questions? Email Yearbook Adviser Amy Jack (ajack@sherwood.k12.or.us)

Purchase a yearbook online, in Parent Vue, under optional fees, or in person at the SHS Bookkeeper with cash or check.

Senior Class Officers

  • President: Finn McEvoy
  • Vice President: Brody Rygh
  • Treasurer: Devin Jedan
  • Activities: Kyla Engstrom
  • At-Large: Linnea Geiszler
  • At-Large: Lynn Gesl
  • At-Large: Finley Moller
  • Red Cross Coordinator: Hailianna Phelps

Senior Class Adviser & Graduation Coordinator

Briana Dannen bdannen@sherwood.k12.or.us
